mentor.tipp_start.kurz: Tip for the first weeks: Click on a province. The sheet shows issues, roads and hospitals; 'Build here' leads directly to policy measures.
mentor.tipp_start.mehr: The 'Infrastructure' layer colors the map by road density and shows individual districts on zoom. This lets you see what is missing before spending funds. Any policy can be targeted to specific provinces, saving political capital and acting locally.
mentor.realzins_hoch.kurz: Real interest rate is high. This slows lending and demand, but only after several months.
mentor.realzins_hoch.mehr: The real rate is the policy rate minus expected inflation. When high, saving yields more than borrowing. This dampens consumption and investment, reducing long-term inflation. Demand reacts after 6-18 months, currency reacts quickly.
mentor.realzins_negativ.kurz: Real interest rate is negative. Saving loses money; this fuels demand and weakens the lira.
mentor.realzins_negativ.mehr: When policy rates lag expected inflation, money loses value monthly. Consumers spend now, investors pull funds. Short-term stimulus comes at the cost of higher inflation and currency depreciation.
mentor.lira_schwach.kurz: The lira lost more ground than inflation explains. Imports become costlier, feeding into prices.
mentor.lira_schwach.mehr: A weak currency increases import costs for energy and inputs. This feeds into inflation after several weeks to months. Exporters benefit.
mentor.glaubwuerdigkeit.kurz: Confidence in the central bank is low. Expectations are unanchored.
mentor.glaubwuerdigkeit.mehr: When households and firms doubt the bank will curb inflation, they pre-emptively raise prices and wages. Credibility builds slowly and erodes fast.
mentor.kapital.kurz: Your political capital is almost spent. Prioritize your actions carefully.
mentor.kapital.mehr: Capital grows with government trust and a parliamentary majority. Small targeted projects cost less than nationwide ones. Unanswered events further erode approval.
mentor.kapital_knapp.kurz: Capital is scarce. Save first, then spend targeted.
mentor.kapital_knapp.mehr: Capital replenishes on the first of each month for laws, talks and events. Exhausting it leaves you vulnerable to crises. Faction talks cost 1, bills often tenfold.
mentor.mehrheit.kurz: Your bloc lacks about {luecke} votes for a majority. Laws become costly and uncertain.
mentor.mehrheit.mehr: You can purchase votes (costs capital and creates a pledge) or recruit partners through event offers. Broken pledges cost partners.
mentor.ruhig.kurz: No conspicuous developments right now. Click any figure in the economic file for details.
mentor.ruhig.mehr: I will alert you when noteworthy dynamics arise, explaining how systems connect rather than prescribing choices.
mentor.waehler_verstimmt.mehr: Reason: {gruende}. Discontent voters seek alternatives in the next election. Review their desires in the 'Voters' tab.
mentor.partner_wackelt.kurz: {rolle} {name} is on the verge of breaking away.
mentor.partner_wackelt.mehr: A departing partner withdraws their seats. Loyalty rises with fulfilled pledges and meetings (1 capital) and drops with deferrals and broken promises.
